Hello,

Thank you for your reply. We understand the outfit picker has been removed and that the app now applies a keyword filter to prompts.

However, upon re-review we still found that the app generates sexually suggestive images of the AI character from free-text descriptions that do not contain any of the filtered keywords. In addition, we were not able to locate a way to report a generated image or to block a user from within the app.

Please note that filtering only the prompt text may not be sufficient for an AI image generator. Consider whether the generated output is also checked before it is shown.

Guideline 1.2 - Safety - User-Generated Content

Once you have addressed these issues, please resubmit your app and include specific details in the App Review notes about what has changed.

If you would like to discuss this further, you can request an App Review appointment.

Best regards,
App Review
